other_facts: Grid 4 rows x 5 cols = 20 cells; panels cost exactly their own area, no separate currency
Sizes 1-8. Type is DERIVED from size: Battle 4-8, Support 2-3, Helper 1
Legal deck requires >=1 battle, >=1 support, >=1 helper
Every 1-cell helper observed had nature なし
Battle panels each have exactly 3 relationship chars (あいしょう); adjacency = chime+sparkle+extra HP; owner recalls internal name approx 'j soul' (UNVERIFIED)
Most helpers require a facing (up/down/left/right) set after placement -> 2-bit per-placed-panel field in deck save
Stickers: Leader (battle only), L and R (battle or support) bind to shoulder buttons
Deck select shows per-deck B/S/H counters; 7 rows + NEW seen, consistent with 8 slots at 0x020AFEB4
Shape filter is two-stage (size first, then shapes); size 5 showed ~13 shapes (counted off screenshot, +/-1; free pentominoes = 12)

k2_predictions_to_check: P1 nature = field with exactly 4 distinct values across 890 records; candidates 0x6,0x7,0xA,0xB or low bits of 0x2

P3 type is derived not stored; a 3-value field is a cached type, check against size
P4 size = field with 8 distinct values, but may not be stored at all (derivable from kshape geometry)

P5 kshape.bin 1.6KB / 0x14 = ~81 shapes total => hand-picked set (all free polyominoes 1-8 would be 533). PREDICT KShapeGroupId@0x8 ~= size, KShapeElementId@0x9 ~= shape within size. If true, size comes free from 0x8.

P6 Koma.NameTable 43 entries ~= ~40 series emblems in series filter => nameIdx@0x4 is SERIES index, nameNum@0x5 is character slot within series. Retires the 'letters=1 -> Eyeshield 21?' question mark.
P7 3 relationships per battle panel does NOT fit in 6 unknown bytes => separate table; piece.bin (35KB, unopened) is prime suspect
